name: Bonduelle SCA
summary: Bonduelle SCA provides plant-based products in France, the United States, Southern Europe, Germany, Eurasia, Northern Europe, Central and Eastern Europe, and internationally. It operates through Canned, Frozen, and Fresh segments. The company offers canned, frozen, and ready-to-use fresh vegetables, including peas, corn, pickles, and letcho. It also provides ambient, processed fresh, and prepared vegetables. In addition, the company engages in mass and commercial catering; and reinsurance activities.
